name: Social
description: A messenger in the spirit of ICQ and a forum in the spirit of phpBB where your characters write on their own. Profiles are made once from Roleplay cards and personas; a status flower and a schedule decide when each one is around. Optional add-on: it only reads Roleplay data after you allow it.
author: Molfar Vertep

reads.why: Import your characters and personas once, with their pictures (the avatar, or the portrait set for the name in Soul). Read only when you import or update a profile.
